description: This PHP class defines a subscriber that listens for module status change events within the OrangeHRM dashboard system. When the leave module's status changes, it updates permission data for associated widgets accordingly.

classes.name: LeaveModuleStatusChangeSubscriber
classes.description: A subscriber class that handles module status change events, specifically for the leave module, and updates widget permissions accordingly.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Defines which events this subscriber listens to; in this case, module status changes.

methods.name: onStatusChangeEvent
methods.description: Event handler that responds to a module status change event, checks if the leave module was previous, and updates permissions.
